svg.aria-label: lockmq demo, four steps. 1: in lox run, the human types the broker password the lock's console asks for. 2: an agent (here Claude Code) makes its first requests to the broker, lockmq_queues among them; lox run shows the question "connect on dev/dev" and the human presses y. 3: the agent gets the three queues of the vhost orders, then calls lockmq_read on the stream order-events; lox run approves it by a rule and lists it in its feed as auto:action. 4: the agent gets the messages with the customer's email replaced by <redacted:r1.1>.

svg.text: You type the broker password in lox run. The agent never holds it.
The first connection waits for your answer, in lox run.
A stream read passes on the default rules, and shows in the feed.
The messages come back with the customer's email masked.
